phases.objective: Make local Staging post-build image provenance discovery deterministic and PowerShell 5.1-safe while preserving exact-SHA fail-closed identity checks and leaving Production authority unchanged.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the Staging AutoPilot against an exact governed source SHA after the Docker build completes
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: AutoPilot reuses any already-proven exact local Staging image immediately from authoritative local sources, falls back through bounded Docker discovery only when needed, verifies commit/tree/build-context provenance, and fails closed on missing or mismatched identity without any Production mutation.
steps: Build the Staging application image from the exact governed source tree and canonical build context.
On the next run, verify and short-circuit on the persisted exact image pin before consulting weaker discovery sources.
If needed, verify the immutable image ID of the already-running Staging app container before consulting Compose tags or repository-wide label indexes.
Treat Compose/tag/label discovery as bounded fallback sources whose failure cannot invalidate an already-proven exact image.
Require exact commit/tree/context provenance for every accepted candidate and fail closed when no candidate proves exact identity.
Preserve the existing deployment-info and runtime attestation checks against the same source SHA.
Do not dispatch, promote, mutate, or otherwise authorize Production from this declaration.
assertions: PowerShell 5.1-compatible image verification remains exact-SHA and strict-mode safe.
The exact-image reuse smoke executes on a Windows runner so its PowerShell 5.1 short-circuit path cannot silently skip under Linux.
A verified STAGING_APP_IMAGE_ID env pin is accepted immediately without depending on later Docker discovery.
A running Staging container contributes its immutable Docker .Image ID as an independently verified candidate.
Compose image references and provenance-label indexes remain fallback discovery paths only.
Failure of a later optional discovery source cannot invalidate an image that already passed exact provenance verification.
The portable Staging manifest is updated to the exact Start-AutoPilot.ps1 content hash.
Generated Remote MCP inventory refresh remains repository-derived evidence and is not an independent environment source.
Production mutation, Production deployment, provider mutation, database mutation, force push, and secret inclusion remain false.
